name: Jungle Shikar Elephant
shortDescription: Hand-carved Kadamb wood elephant draped in a lush jungle Shikargah scene of trees and wildlife.
description: Hand-carved from a single block of Kadamb (Burflower) wood, this standing elephant wears a ceremonial drape carved with a living jungle — a little elephant ambling beneath spreading trees, framed by a dense canopy of scalloped foliage and finished with a floral rosette across the back. Every leaf, border and toenail is worked entirely by hand and sealed with a soft matte polish that lets the warm honey grain glow. Its calm, all-over-detailed presence makes it wonderfully versatile — equally at home as desk branding, in interior design and home decor, as a corporate gift, or as a showcase and exhibition centrepiece. As each one is individually carved, no two are ever alike.

details.label: Use cases
details.value: Desk branding, home & interior decor, corporate gifting, showcases, exhibitions

faqs.question: Is this product handmade?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each elephant is carved entirely by hand by skilled Jaipur artisans from a single block of wood, so every piece is unique.

faqs.question: What material is it made from?
faqs.answer: It is carved from Kadamb wood, also known as the Burflower tree — a fine-grained wood prized for detailed hand-carving.

faqs.question: What is the jungle Shikargah design?
faqs.answer: The drape is carved with a forest scene in the Shikargah tradition — a small elephant among trees and dense foliage — a motif celebrating nature and the wild.

faqs.question: What sizes are available?
faqs.answer: Standard sizes are 3, 4, 5 and 6 inches. Larger pieces up to 12 inches can be made on demand.

faqs.question: Do you offer bulk pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Single pieces are ₹700 each. For bulk orders with a minimum order quantity of 50, the price is ₹500 per piece.

faqs.question: Can the piece be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes, side customisation is available, and we accept both single-piece and bulk orders.

faqs.question: How do I care for it?
faqs.answer: Dust gently with a dry, soft cloth and keep it away from direct sunlight and moisture to preserve the natural grain.
